page_title: WHU 3-2 NOT | West Ham v Nottingham Forest 12/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+9' David Moyes prepares a substitution. Lucas Paqueta is replaced by Aaron Cresswell (West Ham).
90+7' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
90+5' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
90+5' Substitution. Mohammed Kudus did his best and is replaced by Angelo Ogbonna (West Ham).

90+4' Divock Origi (Nottingham) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the roof of the net. Alphonse Areola has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save. Nottingham force a corner. They send men into the box.
90+3' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
90+2' Nottingham have been awarded a corner kick.
90' The game has come to an end for Ibrahim Sangare. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Divock Origi (Nottingham).
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.

88' 3 - 2 Goal! James Ward-Prowse sent in a fine cross from the corner kick. The perfect pass found Tomas Soucek (West Ham) and his precise header from around the penalty spot went into the bottom left corner. 3:2.
88' Now West Ham have a corner.
88' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Now West Ham have a corner.
86' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

85' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the goal, but Odysseas Vlachodimos keeps it out.
85' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes the corner which is cleared.
84' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) whips in a dangerous corner straight at goal, but it is cleared off the line by a defender. West Ham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

83' Emerson (West Ham) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The linesman points to the corner flag, West Ham are going to take it.
83' West Ham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

82' Kurt Zouma (West Ham) leaps high near the penalty spot and gets a header in from the free kick. It's on target, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save to deny the effort. It was a difficult header and it's always tough to put the ball inside the net from positions like that.
79' Substitution. Edson Alvarez makes way for Michail Antonio (West Ham).
79' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
76' Steven Cooper decides to make a substitution. Ola Aina will be replaced by Serge Aurier (Nottingham).
76' Here is a change. Taiwo Awoniyi is going off and Steven Cooper gives the last tactical orders to Chris Wood (Nottingham).
76' The referee signals a substitution. Willy Boly (Nottingham) is brought on as a substitute for Murillo.
75' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
73' The resulting corner from James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

72' That's unlucky! James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for West Ham.
70' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) picks up a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot goalwards that crashes against the bar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
68' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
65' 2 - 2 Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the right side of the goal. The score is 2:2.
65' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
64' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) receives a yellow card for infringement.
63' 1 - 2 Goal! Ola Aina tees up Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom right corner. 1:2.
62' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
61' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
60' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Michael Salisbury ignores the protests.
57' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
56' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes the free kick and curls the ball just over the crossbar. That was close! The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
54' The foul by Moussa Niakhate (Nottingham) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Michael Salisbury.
53' The resulting corner, taken by Jarrod Bowen (West Ham), comes to nothing.
53' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Vladimir Coufal (West Ham), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. West Ham earn a corner.
52' A lofted cross from Ola Aina (Nottingham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.

49' The opposition back off Emerson (West Ham) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies a whisker wide of the right post. Unlucky! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
48' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
47' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
46' Half-time substitution. Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) is replaced by Danilo.
46' Michael Salisbury blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
45+2' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' 1 - 1 Goal! Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 1:1.

44' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Alphonse Areola shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
44' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

43' A cross by Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
41' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
40' A pass from Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is intercepted by Alphonse Areola and the move breaks down.
37' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
35' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
34' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
31' Nottingham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
28' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Jarrod Bowen. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
25' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
24' The corner from Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is intercepted by Alphonse Areola.
23' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
22' Michael Salisbury shows a yellow card to Vladimir Coufal (West Ham), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
20' Michael Salisbury has a clear sight and sees a foul from Orel Mangala (Nottingham).
18' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Harry Toffolo (Nottingham).
17' Murillo (Nottingham) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
15' The game is interrupted now, Murillo (Nottingham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

14' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Odysseas Vlachodimos was alert and the score remained the same.
12' An attempted cross from Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) is cleared.
10' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
8' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
6' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to West Ham.
6' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
3' 1 - 0 GOAL! Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 1:0.
2' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Nottingham will kick-off.
Michael Salisbury will supervise the game today.
